title: raydepsets config
description: Schema for ci/raydepsets *.depsets.yaml config files. Each depset entry is validated against the schema for its operation: compile, expand, subset, or relax.

build_arg_sets.description: Named sets of build args. A depset listing a build arg set under its own build_arg_sets key is expanded once per set, with ${VAR} placeholders substituted.

operation.description: How this depset is produced: compile (uv pip compile from requirements/packages), expand (recompile the union of other depsets plus extra requirements), subset (recompile a subset of requirements constrained by a source depset's lock), relax (remove packages from a source depset's lock file).

compile.description: Compile a lock file from requirements files and/or a list of packages with uv pip compile.

output.description: Workspace-relative path of the lock file to write.

packages.description: Package specifiers to compile, passed to uv via stdin.

append_flags.description: uv flags appended to the default flags.

override_flags.description: uv flags replacing same-named default flags.

include_setuptools.description: Keep setuptools in the lock file instead of marking it unsafe.

pre_hooks.description: Shell commands run before this depset builds.

build_arg_sets.description: Build arg set names this depset is expanded for.

expand.description: Recompile the union of other depsets' requirements plus optional extra requirements into one lock file.

output.description: Workspace-relative path of the lock file to write.

depsets.description: Names of depsets to expand from.

requirements.description: Extra workspace-relative requirements files to include.

append_flags.description: uv flags appended to the default flags.

override_flags.description: uv flags replacing same-named default flags.

include_setuptools.description: Keep setuptools in the lock file instead of marking it unsafe.

pre_hooks.description: Shell commands run before this depset builds.

build_arg_sets.description: Build arg set names this depset is expanded for.

subset.description: Recompile a subset of a source depset's requirements, constrained by the source depset's lock file.

output.description: Workspace-relative path of the lock file to write.

source_depset.description: Name of the depset whose lock file constrains this subset.

requirements.description: Requirements files to keep; must be a subset of the source depset's requirements.

append_flags.description: uv flags appended to the default flags.

override_flags.description: uv flags replacing same-named default flags.

include_setuptools.description: Keep setuptools in the lock file instead of marking it unsafe.

pre_hooks.description: Shell commands run before this depset builds.

build_arg_sets.description: Build arg set names this depset is expanded for.

relax.description: Remove packages from a source depset's lock file without recompiling.

output.description: Workspace-relative path of the lock file to write. Defaults to overwriting the source depset's lock file.

source_depset.description: Name of the depset whose lock file is relaxed.

packages.description: Packages to remove from the lock file.

pre_hooks.description: Shell commands run before this depset builds.

build_arg_sets.description: Build arg set names this depset is expanded for.
